domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
x is real and satisfies 0 <= x < 1
m is defined as floor of n times x, hence m is an integer
m divided by n is defined (requires n not equal to 0, satisfied by n > 1)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1 and every real x with 0 <= x < 1, if m is the floor of n times x, then E(n, x) is less than or equal to E(n, m divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all integers n greater than 1
for all real numbers x with 0 <= x < 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer parameter in E; also input to floor

variables.domain: real interval from 0 inclusive to 1 exclusive
variables.name: x
variables.role: argument to E(n, x); also used to define m

variables.name: m
variables.role: defined as floor(n*x); used to form m/n

witness_dependencies: m depends on n and x via m = floor(n*x)
the comparison target m/n depends on n and x through m

statement_nl: Let n be an integer greater than 1. If x is a real number with 0 <= x < 1 and m = floor(n*x), then E(n, x) <= E(n, m/n).
